The snapshot redacts AuxiliaryDistributedLedger, AuxiliaryTechnicalReference and AuxiliaryMechanism as "<locked>", so no chain or contract address is available here and no CAIP-19 can be constructed from a DTI record directly. Links to CAIP-19 are inferred from names in data/links-inferred.json, with the accuracy limits documented there.
